source_note: Verified Kiswahili Form One schemes of work (Arusha Catholic Seminary, ARUCASE) for Term I and Term II. 2 periods per week (1 x 80-min double period + 1 x 40-min single period). Term I covers Sura 1-3 (main competences 1.0-3.0); Term II covers Sura 4-7 (main competences 4.0-7.0). Week 10 of each term is mid-term assessment and break.
